an6.25:1.4: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
an6.25:1.5: yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti. na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti. na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
an6.25:1.6: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti. nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
an6.25:1.7: gedhoti kho bhikkhave pañcannetaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.25:1.8: idampi kho bhikkhave ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visujjhanti. (2)

an6.25:2.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.

an6.25:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako devatā anussarati:
an6.25:6.2: santi devā cātummahārājikā, santi devā tāvatiṃsā, santi devā yāmā, santi devā tusitā, santi devā nimmāṇaratino, santi devā paranimmitavasavattino, santi devā brahmakāyikā, santi devā tatuttariṃ
an6.25:6.3: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā, mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati,

an6.25:7.1: yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsaṃ ca devatānaṃ saddhañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.25:7.2: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
an6.25:7.3: gedhoti kho bhikkhave pañcannetaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
